- Yellow chlorosis spreading inward from margins
- Overall V-shaped browning pattern at the leaf edges
- No concentric rings, no white coating, no discrete spots

This pattern (marginal necrosis + surrounding yellowing in a V-shape) strongly suggests **Verticillium Wilt**. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image for Verticillium Wilt shows exactly the same pattern as the test image:
- V-shaped brown necrotic area at/near leaf margin
- Yellow chlorotic halo surrounding the necrosis
- Green tissue in the rest of the leaf

This is a strong visual match. The test image has the same marginal browning with yellowing transitioning to green — the classic Verticillium Wilt signature on tomato leaves.
